title: Hours & Location
content: Eleanor's Tavern, 31-09 Broadway, Astoria, NY 11106. Phone (718) 555-0110. Closed Monday. Lunch Tue-Fri 11:30am-3:00pm. Dinner Tue-Sun 5:00pm to close (11:00pm weeknights and Sunday, midnight Friday and Saturday). Patio open April through October, weather permitting.

title: About
content: Eleanor's Tavern is named for Carlton McGee's late grandmother, Eleanor McGee. We opened on Broadway in Astoria in 2015 with her pot roast recipe at the center of the menu. Carlton runs the front of the house with manager Sophia Kastner, while his brother Daniel McGee leads the kitchen. We serve traditional and modern American tavern food with American wine and craft beer.

title: Private Events
content: Host your celebration at Eleanor's Tavern. Our back room seats up to 30 guests for rehearsal dinners, birthdays, and office parties. We build family-style menus around Eleanor's Pot Roast and Chef Daniel's seasonal plates, with wine pairings from Hudson Valley Wine Imports. To inquire, email carlton@eleanorstavern.com or call (718) 555-0110.

title: Reservations
content: Reservations are recommended for Friday and Saturday dinner. Book online or call (718) 555-0110. A small deposit holds large parties on weekend nights. We hold a portion of the dining room and patio for walk-ins every night.

title: Wine & Beer List
content: American Wine by the Glass: Finger Lakes Riesling $12, Willamette Pinot Noir $14, Napa Cabernet $16, Sonoma Chardonnay $13, Hudson Valley Rosé $11. Craft Beer: Brooklyn Lager $8, SingleCut IPA $9, Astoria Pilsner $8, Seasonal Stout $9. Curated with Hudson Valley Wine Imports. Ask your server about our fall American wine series.

title: Our Story
content: Carlton McGee grew up cooking alongside his grandmother Eleanor, whose pot roast became the soul of this tavern. After years in New York kitchens, Carlton opened Eleanor's Tavern on Broadway in Astoria in 2015. Today his brother Daniel leads the kitchen and his wife Ellen keeps the books, making this a true family tavern.

title: Catering
content: Bring Eleanor's Tavern to your event. We cater family-style tavern spreads built around Eleanor's Pot Roast, Chef Daniel's seasonal plates, and house-made pies. Drop-off and on-site options available across Astoria and Queens. Email carlton@eleanorstavern.com to plan your menu.

title: Gift Cards
content: Give the gift of Eleanor's Tavern. Digital and physical gift cards are available in any amount through our Square checkout. Perfect for birthdays, holidays, and thank-yous. Redeemable for lunch, dinner, and private events.

title: Jazz Sundays
content: Join us for live jazz every Sunday evening at Eleanor's Tavern. We pour American wine and craft beer while a trio plays the standards Carlton loves, Miles, Coltrane, and more. Dinner service runs alongside the music. No cover; reservations recommended for larger parties.

title: Private Events Inquiry
content: Tell us about your event and we'll follow up within a day. Our back room seats up to 30 for rehearsal dinners, birthdays, and office parties. Include your date, party size, and any menu preferences. Email carlton@eleanorstavern.com or call (718) 555-0110.

title: Patio Season
content: Our 24-seat patio is open April through October, weather permitting. Enjoy grilled fish, the tavern burger, and a cold craft beer in the Astoria evening air. Patio seating is first-come for walk-ins, with a portion held nightly.

title: Lunch Menu
content: Served Tue-Fri 11:30am-3:00pm. Steak Sandwich $19, Tavern Burger $18, Fish & Chips $21, Clam Chowder cup $9 / bowl $13, Shepherd's Pie $24, Tavern Wings $14, Garden Salad $11. Add a side of Garlic Mashed Potatoes $8 or Mac & Cheese $9.

title: Holiday Hours
content: Thanksgiving: closed. Christmas Eve: dinner service 4:00pm-9:00pm. Christmas Day: closed. New Year's Eve: special prix fixe seatings, reservations required. New Year's Day: closed. Regular hours otherwise; always closed Monday.

title: Press
content: Eleanor's Tavern has been featured for its grandmother's pot roast and Astoria warmth. For press inquiries and review requests, email carlton@eleanorstavern.com. We're happy to host writers any afternoon before dinner service.

title: Careers
content: Join the Eleanor's Tavern family. We hire servers, line cooks, hosts, and bartenders who care about hospitality and good food. Send a note and your experience to sophia.k@eleanorstavern.com. We're a closed-Monday house with a tight-knit team.

title: Wine Series
content: Our fall American craft wine series pairs Chef Daniel's small plates with Finger Lakes whites and Willamette Pinots, curated with Hudson Valley Wine Imports. Limited seats per tasting; reserve online. Dates announced each September.

title: Contact
content: Eleanor's Tavern, 31-09 Broadway, Astoria, NY 11106. Phone (718) 555-0110. Email carlton@eleanorstavern.com. Take the N or W train to Broadway. Closed Monday. For private events, ask for Carlton; for reservations, ask for Sophia.

title: Dessert Menu
content: House Apple Pie $10, Bourbon Pecan Pie $11, Seasonal Cobbler $10, Warm Chocolate Cake $11, Vanilla Bean Cheesecake $10. All pies are house-made daily. Ask about pairing a dessert with a glass of port or a dark roast coffee.
